quote: One day you will wake up, and there won't be any more time to do the things you have always wanted to do.
author: Paulo Coelho

quote: Don't be hard on your parents because it's also their first time living the life. They are also humans. They can make mistakes too.
author: Anonymous

quote: If you spend your time chasing butterflies, they will fly away, but if you spend time making a beautiful garden, the butterfly will come.
author: Mário Quintana

quote: A comfort zone is a beautiful place, but nothing ever grows there.
author: Anonymous

quote: The biggest risk is not taking any risk. In a world that is changing really quickly, the only strategy that is guaranteed to fail is not taking risk.
author: Mark Zuckerberg

quote: We must all suffer from one of two pains: the pain of discipline or the pain of regret.
author: Jim Rohn

quote: You will never change your life until you change something you do daily. The secret of your success is found in you, your daily routine.
author: Mike Murdock

quote: If you are persistent, you will get it. If you are consistent, you will keep it.
author: Harvey Mackay

quote: It's only after we've lost everything that we're free to do anything.
author: Chuck Palahniuk

quote: We don't see things as they are. We see them as we are.
author: Anaïs Nin

quote: If a man does not know what harbor he is making for, no wind is favorable.
author: Seneca

quote: Everything works if you work. Everything stops if you stop.
author: Anonymous

quote: We romanticize the stars, but forget the dark is what made them visible.
author: Anonymous
